root_cause.text: The tracing trigger cleanup path fails to drain the deferred free list when the cleanup kthread cannot be created, leaving previously queued entries leaked and causing a NULL pointer dereference when subsequent code attempts to wake up the NULL kthread pointer.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states "boot-deferred nodes can accumulate on trigger_data_free_list, later frees fall back to synchronously freeing only the current object, and the older queued entries are leaked forever" and "This triggers a NULL pointer dereference and crashes the kernel." The patch adds `trigger_data_free_queued_locked()` to drain the whole list synchronously when kthread creation fails, and a late-init drain path to catch boot-time stranded entries.
